sentences.zh: “作为我们特别新闻简报的结尾，”

sentences.en: said the voice of the television announcer, 'we're going over to the macaroni fields of Calabria.
sentences.zh: 电视播音员的声音说，“我们现在到卡拉布里亚的通心粉田去看看。

sentences.en: Macaroni has been grown in this area for over six hundred years.
sentences.zh: 这个地区种植通心粉已有六百多年了。

sentences.en: Two of the leading growers Giuseppe Moldova and Riccardo Brabante,
sentences.zh: 两位主要的种植者朱塞皮·莫尔多瓦和里卡多·布拉班特

sentences.en: tell me that they have been expecting a splendid crop this year and harvesting has begun earlier than usual.
sentences.zh: 告诉我，他们今年一直盼着有个好收成，收割比往年开始得早。

sentences.en: Here you can see two workers who, between them,
sentences.zh: 这里您可以看到两位工人，他们俩

sentences.en: have just finished cutting three cartloads of golden brown macaroni stalks.
sentences.zh: 刚刚割完三车金褐色的通心粉秆。

sentences.en: The whole village has been working day and night gathering and threshing this year's crop before the September rains.
sentences.zh: 全村人日夜不停地收割、脱粒，要在九月的雨季之前完成今年的收成。

sentences.en: On the right, you can see Mrs. Brabante herself.
sentences.zh: 在右边，您可以看到布拉班特夫人本人。

sentences.en: She has been helping her husband for thirty years now.
sentences.zh: 她帮助丈夫干活至今已有三十年了。

sentences.en: Mrs. Brabante is talking to the manager of the local factory where the crop is processed.
sentences.zh: 布拉班特夫人正在和当地加工这种作物的工厂经理谈话。

sentences.en: This last scene shows you what will happen at the end of the harvest:
sentences.zh: 这最后一组镜头向您展示收割结束时会发生什么：
著名的卡拉布里亚吃通心粉比赛！

sentences.en: Signor Fratelli, the present champion, has won it every year since 1991.
sentences.zh: 目前的冠军弗拉泰利先生自1991年以来年年夺冠。

sentences.en: And that ends our special bulletin for today, Thursday, April 1st.
sentences.zh: 我们今天的特别新闻简报到此结束，今天是星期四，四月一日。

sentences.en: We're now going back to the studio.'
